title: Submit a draft order
objective: Confirm the valid transition from DRAFT to SUBMITTED.
preconditions: A synthetic order exists in DRAFT state.

test_data.name: draft order
test_data.description: A synthetic order currently shown in DRAFT state.

steps.expected_result: The order is submitted and its state changes to SUBMITTED.

postconditions: The synthetic order is in SUBMITTED state.
cleanup: Remove the synthetic order using an approved test-environment procedure.
notes: Selected implementation evidence sets PROCESSING, which diverges from the authoritative SUBMITTED result. The expected result remains based on ORD-003.
